title: 采购订单保存时校验显式归属销售订单并统一来源快照
description: Stage3 core operational closure under explicit 2026-10-08 user priority. Reuse existing entities/layers/services and audit, no new report/Agent/schema/production actions or permission expansion. Fix verified source-link/state gaps with minimal complete files.
acceptance_criteria: When authorized purchase user explicitly links OwningSalesOrderId, resolve a live approved sales order using current-user sales/customer data scope and existing module permissions; reject nonpositive/missing/deleted/canceled/out-of-scope source, incompatible owning customer/product/unit. Derive order number and customer name from authoritative source, never trust conflicting client snapshots.

Support unlinked procurement for stock without fabricating sales links. Preserve original commercial currencies/prices and calculate purchase totals through existing method; no forced currency equality or cross-currency sums, no silent sales/stock/finance mutations. Update rechecks source and permissions; submitted or approved document freeze rules remain.

Integrate existing create/update APIs and audit, fail transaction before saving incompatible source; show meaningful conflict. Test bounded source lookup, authorized link, denied/unmapped user, forged snapshot, invalid products/units, unlinked procurement and source changed between edit/save using real guarded SQL and safe Release build/unit. Amend legacy traceability fixtures to use genuine authorized source instead of dangling dummy IDs.
implementation_evidence: PurchaseOrderController Create/Update copies OwningSalesOrderId/OwningSalesOrderNo/OwningCustomerName from request; Validate checks TaxRate only. It does not resolve or authorize linked sales order or verify source/customer/product/unit, allowing dangling or conflicting sales-procurement tracing.
